# P — Search

**Specs:** `search-results-page` (all four scenarios); the "search results link to the listing anchor, not a detail page" change of `plp-led-catalog-navigation` is implemented here through N's `offerHref`; Product Search integration per D-056
**Depends on:** H, I, N · **Unblocks:** none (generated by verify-plan) · **Decisions:** D-004, D-010, D-011, D-017, D-052, D-053, D-055, D-056
**Owner prerequisites:** none for unit tests; OA-02 (storefront client incl. `view_project_settings`), OA-03 (seed run that activates indexing) for the Chrome checks · **Skill refs:** `commercetools-platform` (Product Search), `commercetools-storefront`

## Goal
`/[locale]/search?q=…` finds offers by name (typo tolerant) or by an exact SKU / part number, shows each result as a compact card whose link opens the offer's category listing at the offer's anchor, can be narrowed by category, sorted and paged (12 per page), and has explicit empty, unsupported-language and error states. A search icon in the header (added by P; undrawn: Junior design choice, D-068) leads to the page.

## Design

Design: **search is not drawn** (`design/DESIGN.md` "Not designed: PDP, search, …"). P builds it from tokens and the existing patterns (title strip, filter chips, cards, pagination from N). Layout is therefore undrawn: **Junior design choice** (D-068), documented here with a one-line rationale in the PR/commit message; screenshots taken by Claude, owner may comment. Tokens only (D-053).

### Route and URL contract (`app/[locale]/search/page.tsx`, Server Component)
`/[locale]/search?q=<text>&category=<categoryKey>&sort=<sortId>&page=<n>`
- `q`: trimmed, whitespace collapsed, truncated to `MAX_QUERY_LENGTH = 100`. Fewer than `MIN_QUERY_LENGTH = 2` characters = "start" state (no search call).
- `category`: a **category key** (stable across locales, e.g. `malva-cat-cable-internet`) = the offer's primary category (`categoryKeys[0]`); unknown value ignored.
- `sort`: `relevance` (default, omitted) | `price-asc` | `price-desc` (master-variant price, nulls last); other values ignored.
- `page`: ≥ 1, default 1; past the last page → last page (same rule as N).
- Parsing/serialising: `lib/search/params.ts` (`parseSearchParams`, `toSearchQueryString`; page reset on `q`/`category`/`sort` change).
- `/api/search` (GET, Route Handler `app/api/search/route.ts`) takes the same params and returns the same data as JSON for tests and for Chrome index polling:
```json
{ "query": "cable 500", "total": 2, "truncated": false, "page": 1, "pageCount": 1,
  "categories": [{ "key": "malva-cat-cable-internet", "name": "Cable internet", "count": 2 }],
  "results": [{ "offerKey": "malva-offer-cable-500", "name": "Cable 500", "categoryKey": "malva-cat-cable-internet", "matchedSku": null, "fromPrice": { "centAmount": 5999, "currencyCode": "USD" }, "href": "/en-US/shop/cable-internet?offer=malva-offer-cable-500#offer-malva-offer-cable-500" }],
  "state": "results" }
```
`state` is one of `start | results | none | unsupported-language | error`. Errors use E's `{ error: { code, message } }` with HTTP 502 code `SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE` only for upstream failures; an empty result is HTTP 200 (`state: "none"`).

### Product Search integration (D-056) — `lib/ct/search.ts` (P section)
Docs: [Product Search](https://docs.commercetools.com/api/projects/product-search), [search query language](https://docs.commercetools.com/api/search-query-language) (`exact`, `fullText`, `fuzzy`, `boost`, `limit` 1–100, `offset` ≤ 9900). Endpoint: `POST /{projectKey}/products/search` (SDK `products().search().post({ body })` if present in the installed `@commercetools/platform-sdk`; else a typed `fetch` with the bearer token from E's client; record which in the file header comment). Scope `view_products` (OA-02). Search returns **only Product ids** (plus `matchingVariants`), so offers come from H's cached catalog.
```ts
// P: offer text search
export interface OfferSearchHit { id: string; matchedSkus: string[] }
export interface OfferSearchResult { total: number; hits: OfferSearchHit[] }   // hits ≤ 100, relevance order
export function normalizeQuery(raw: string): string                            // trim, collapse spaces, max 100
export function looksLikeSku(q: string): boolean                               // /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{3,}$/ after normalize, no spaces
export function buildOfferTextQuery(input: { text: string; locale: 'en-US' | 'de-DE' }): ProductSearchRequestBody
export async function searchOfferHits(input: { text: string; locale: 'en-US' | 'de-DE' }): Promise<OfferSearchResult>
export async function getSearchLanguages(): Promise<string[]>                  // project languages, cached 1 h
```
Request body built by `buildOfferTextQuery` (**one compound query, one round trip**, as the spec's modeling note requires):
```json
{
  "query": { "or": [
    { "exact":    { "field": "variants.sku", "value": "<q>", "caseInsensitive": true, "boost": 10 } },
    { "fullText": { "field": "name", "language": "<locale>", "value": "<q>", "boost": 3 } },
    { "fuzzy":    { "field": "name", "language": "<locale>", "value": "<q>", "level": 2 } }
  ] },
  "limit": 100,
  "offset": 0,
  "markMatchingVariants": true
}
```
- The `exact` SKU clause is included **only when `looksLikeSku(q)`**; `fuzzy` always (the API lowers the level to 1 for 3–5 characters and to 0 for 1–2 characters, so a typo in a term of more than 5 characters tolerates up to 2 edits). `language` = the URL locale (`en-US`/`de-DE`, both configured in the project: en-GB, de-DE, en-US).
- Expression count (≤ 3) and value length (≤ 100 < 256) respect the 50-expression / 256-character limits.
- **Planner default (facets, sort and paging in memory):** the catalog is ~40 offers, so P requests the top `limit: 100` hits once and does category counts, price sort and the 12-per-page slice **in memory** over the mapped, listable offers (stable, testable, and consistent with N's `isListable`/`dedupeByAnchors` which Product Search cannot express). If `total > 100` the page shows the notice `search.truncated` ("Showing the 100 best matches. Refine your search.") and `/api/search` returns `truncated: true`. The Product Search `distinct` facet and `postFilter` are intentionally not used in v1.
- `searchOfferHits` maps `results[].id` and `matchingVariants.matchedVariants[].sku` (empty when `allMatched`).
- `getSearchLanguages()`: `GET /{projectKey}` (Project) → `languages` (needs `view_project_settings`, OA-02), cached 3600 s in memory (`SEARCH_LANGUAGES_TTL_SECONDS` in `lib/config/search.ts`).
- **Index lag (D-056):** changes to products reach the index after minutes; a new or renamed offer is simply not found until then. P adds **no** catalog-substring fallback (it would hide lag and make search disagree with the index). Tests never wait for the index (they mock `searchOfferHits`); Chrome checks run `npm run search:wait` first (task P-09).

### Result assembly (`lib/search/run.ts`, pure given its inputs; N-02's rules reused)
```ts
export interface SearchResultItem {
  offerKey: string; name: string; kind: 'plan' | 'addon' | 'equipment' | 'device';
  categoryKey: string; categoryName: string;
  fromPrice: Money | null;            // master variant price
  matchedSku: string | null;          // set when the query is a variant SKU (any variant, case-insensitive) or the API reported a partial variant match
  highlight: string | null;           // first plan highlight, else null
  href: string;                       // offerHref(...)
}
export interface SearchView { state: 'start'|'results'|'none'|'unsupported-language'|'error'; query: string; total: number; truncated: boolean; items: SearchResultItem[] /* current page */; categories: { key: string; name: string; count: number }[]; page: number; pageCount: number }
export async function runSearch(params: SearchParams, deps: { locale; market; tree; languages: string[]; searchOfferHits; getOffersByIds }): Promise<SearchView>
```
Order of work:
1. `q` shorter than 2 → `state: 'start'`.
2. `languages` does not include `locale` → `state: 'unsupported-language'` (never a plain "none"; spec scenario). (The URL locale is always en-US/de-DE today; the guard protects against a mis-configured project.)
3. `searchOfferHits` throws → `state: 'error'` (one `console.error('[search] failed', { code })`, no query text in logs).
4. Map hit ids with `getOffersByIds`, drop unknown ids, apply `isListable` then `dedupeByAnchors` (hit order kept).
5. **Exact part number first:** `skuMatch = offers.filter(o => o.variants.some(v => v.sku.toUpperCase() === q.toUpperCase()))` moved to the front (stable); each gets `matchedSku` = that variant's SKU. Other items get `matchedSku` from the API's `matchedSkus[0]` only when non-empty. SKUs are unique per project, so at most one product matches exactly; **Planner default** (open question "pasted identifier matches more than one product"): if more than one matches (case-variant duplicates), all are shown first, in API order, each flagged. There is no disambiguation page and no automatic redirect.
6. Category counts by `categoryKeys[0]` of the filtered list (chips: "Cable internet (2)"), `category` filter, sort (`relevance` keeps step 5's order), page slice (12, `LISTING_PAGE_SIZE` from `lib/config/listing.ts`, N), `state: items.length ? 'results' : 'none'`.
No-op for an empty `hits`: `state: 'none'`.

### Components (`components/search/`, owned by P)
- `SearchForm` (server-rendered `<form role="search" method="get" action="/{locale}/search">`, no client JS): label (visually hidden) `search.inputLabel`, pill input (`--radius-pill`, 1px `--color-neutral-400` border, height 56 px, `type="search"`, `name="q"`, `maxLength=100`, `defaultValue={q}`, `autoComplete="off"`), submit pill "Search" (`--color-action`, Inter 800 16). Always editable (spec: "the query stays editable"). Submitting resets `category`, `sort`, `page`.
- `SearchTitleStrip`: `--color-brand-100` strip like N's title strip: breadcrumb "Home / Search", H1 `search.title`, the `SearchForm`.
- `ResultsHeader`: `role="status"` text `search.found` ("{count, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} for “{query}”") and the `SortSelect` (reuse N's with the three options `search.sort.*`).
- `CategoryChips`: reuse N's `FilterChips` shape: "All ({total})" + one chip per `categories[]`, `Link`s to `?q=…&category=…`.
- `SearchResultCard`: `Card` (`--radius-xl`), honey header `--color-brand-500` with kind label (Exo 600 12: "Plan" / "Add-on" / "Equipment"/"Device") and name (Exo 700 20), body: category name (muted 14), first highlight (Roboto 16, only plans), "From $59.99/mo" (Exo 700 20; "Price not available" when `fromPrice` is null), **part number line** when `matchedSku`: `Pill` "Part number match" + monospace-free text "{sku}" (Roboto 14), CTA pill link "View in {category}" → `href` (never a detail page; `data-testid="result-link"`). The first card of an exact SKU match carries `aria-label` "Best match: part number {sku}".
- `NoResults`: heading `search.none.title` ("No results for “{query}”"), body `search.none.body` ("Check the spelling or try a shorter term. We cannot suggest corrections, but these categories may help."), then **fallback content** = tiles for `FALLBACK_CATEGORY_KEYS` (config; resolved by key against the tree; missing ones omitted and `console.warn`ed) as links via `categoryHref`, plus the `SearchForm` above stays filled with the query.
- `StartState`: H1, form, "Popular searches" chips from `POPULAR_SEARCHES[locale]` (config) as `Link`s to `?q=<term>`, then the same category tiles. **Planner default:** these are static curated terms; there is **no typeahead / term suggestion**: Search Term Suggestions needs Product Projection Search (unavailable for this project, D-056) and returns nothing for numeric/special input.
- `UnsupportedLanguage`: heading `search.unsupported.title` ("Search is not available in this language"), body, link to switch language (the shell's locale switcher is on the page already; no new control).
- `SearchError`: `search.error.title` ("Search is temporarily unavailable"), body, link "Try again" (same URL).
- `HeaderSearchLink` (client-free `Link`): icon-only magnifier (inline SVG, 20 px, `currentColor`), `aria-label` `search.open`, href `/search`, 44×44 px target, `--color-text-on-brand`, hover bg `--color-brand-600`. **P appends** it to `SiteHeader` (right cluster, before the account link) and as the first item of `MobileDrawer`, each guarded by `HEADER_SEARCH_ENABLED` from `lib/config/search.ts`. The design has no search entry; this is a sign-off request in the final report. Planner default: flag `true`; set it to `false` (one-line change) if the owner rejects it; `/search?q=` stays reachable by URL either way.

### Config (`lib/config/search.ts`)
```ts
export const HEADER_SEARCH_ENABLED = true;
export const MIN_QUERY_LENGTH = 2;
export const MAX_QUERY_LENGTH = 100;
export const MAX_HITS = 100;
export const SEARCH_LANGUAGES_TTL_SECONDS = 3600;
export const FALLBACK_CATEGORY_KEYS = ['malva-cat-phone-plans', 'malva-cat-home-wireless', 'malva-cat-cable-internet', 'malva-cat-add-ons'] as const;
export const POPULAR_SEARCHES = { 'en-US': ['Cable 500', 'Unlimited', 'Spotify', 'Router'], 'de-DE': ['Cable 500', 'Unlimited', 'Spotify', 'Router'] } as const;
```
Answers to the spec's open questions (**Planner defaults**): (1) a pasted identifier matches at most one product because variant SKUs are unique in a project; if several appear they are all shown first and flagged. (2) A real "did you mean" correction is **out of scope** (needs an external search engine); the page never claims a correction, it only returns fuzzy matches. (3) The no-results fallback is **global**, curated in repo config (`FALLBACK_CATEGORY_KEYS`), not per category and not in a CMS.

### SEO
`generateMetadata`: `title` = `search.meta.titleQuery` when `q` present, else `search.meta.title`; `robots: { index: false, follow: true }` (internal search results are not indexed); canonical not needed.

### Pitfalls
- Product Search returns ids only; do not call a projection per hit (N+1). Use H's cached `getOffersByIds`.
- Index lag (minutes; full reindex ~15 min after a product-type change): a "no results" immediately after seeding is expected. Never "fix" it with catalog fallbacks; wait with `npm run search:wait`.
- Only locales configured in the project return results; `de-DE` and `en-US` are configured. Never pass `en-GB` or a locale not in `getSearchLanguages()`.
- `fuzzy` is expensive: exactly one per query. The API itself shortens the level for short terms; do not pre-compute levels.
- Do not log the raw query (may contain personal data); log only the error code.
- `console` `[search]` errors must not leak the project key or tokens.
- A page may not export extra values; shared helpers live in `lib/search/*`.
- Results link to N's `offerHref` only; never build `/shop/...` strings by hand (primary category rule, localized slugs).
- Locale-aware `Link`/`redirect` only; the `<form action>` must include the locale prefix (`/${locale}/search`).
- `HEADER_SEARCH_ENABLED` must be read at render time from the config module (not `process.env`), so tests can mock it.

## Unit tests (scenario → test)
| Scenario (exact title from the spec) | Capability | Test (file → `it(...)` name) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Part number pasted | `search-results-page` | `lib/search/run.test.ts` → "Part number pasted: the offer owning the SKU is first and its card shows the matched SKU"; `lib/ct/search.test.ts` → "Part number pasted: SKU clause is built only for an identifier-shaped query" |
| Query matches nothing | `search-results-page` | `lib/search/run.test.ts` → "Query matches nothing: state is none"; `components/search/states.test.tsx` → "Query matches nothing: states the absence, keeps the query editable and offers the configured fallback tiles" |
| Misspelt query | `search-results-page` | `lib/ct/search.test.ts` → "Misspelt query: a fuzzy expression with level 2 is part of the query"; `lib/search/run.test.ts` → "Misspelt query: hits from the fuzzy path are returned and no correction text is produced" |
| Unsupported language | `search-results-page` | `lib/search/run.test.ts` → "Unsupported language: reports the language is not supported instead of an empty result"; `components/search/states.test.tsx` → "Unsupported language: shows the dedicated message" |

## Chrome verification (run by Claude)
- C-P-1 (needs OA-02, OA-03, G, H): first run `npm run search:wait` in `site/` (blocks until the index returns "Cable 500"; up to 20 min after a seed or reindex), then `GET http://localhost:3000/api/search?q=cable%20500` through the page (navigate to the URL) → JSON with `state: "results"`, `total ≥ 1`, first `offerKey` `malva-offer-cable-500`; keep the result as the index-ready proof.

## Manual tests (owner only)
None.

## Excluded
- "Did you mean" spelling correction: out of scope (needs an external search engine); fuzzy matching only (Planner default).
- Search Term Suggestions / type-ahead: unavailable (requires Product Projection Search, D-056); replaced by curated popular searches.
- Availability and price facets, availability indicator on results (D-019, `product-listing-page` open questions answered in N); contract-pricing overlay (B2B, D-005).
- Detail-page links from results: replaced by `offerHref` (D-052).
